name: Cairo, Nile Cruise and Sharm El Sheikh Tour
destination_label: Cairo, Nile Cruise & Sharm El Sheikh
description: Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy a breathtaking Cairo Nile Cruise and Sharm El Sheikh Tours with Egypt Luxury Tours, be ready to get a glimpse of magic in Cairo while visit Pyramids, Sphinx, then cruising the Nile River to explore fascinating Temples, then with Cairo Nile Cruise and Sharm El Sheikh Luxury Tours get relaxed at the sunny beaches in Sharm El Sheikh.
overview: Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy a breathtaking Cairo Nile Cruise and Sharm El Sheikh Tours with Egypt Luxury Tours, be ready to get a glimpse of magic in Cairo while visit Pyramids, Sphinx, then cruising the Nile River to explore fascinating Temples, then with Cairo Nile Cruise and Sharm El Sheikh Luxury Tours get relaxed at the sunny beaches in Sharm El Sheikh.
highlights: Nile Cruise and Aswan Day Tour
Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
West Bank Tour / Luxor to sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, then he will transfer you to your hotel in Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo Day Tour
itinerary.description: Enjoy tasty breakfast at your hotel, then Ibis Egypt tours tour guide will escort you to Pyramids of Giza and the Egyptian Museum, start your tour by visiting the three Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren and Mykerinus, then move to Panorama area, enjoy fabulous photos for the three Pyramids, next move to the Sphinx, visit the Valley Temple, Enjoy Lunch at oriental restaurant in Cairo, continue your tour by visiting the Egyptian Museum, it is one of the most famous museums in the world, next round will be to Old Cairo including visits to the various Churches there ( Visit maximum 02 churches), visit Ben Ezra Synagogue, at the end of your tour transfer to Giza train station for departure to Aswan by night Sleeper train. Have dinner on train. Overnight in Sleeper Train

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise and Aswan Day Tour
itinerary.description: Ibis Tours Egypt representative will pick you up from Aswan train station, then he will escort you to your Nile River Cruise, check into your Nile Cruise Aswan to Luxor, taste your unforgettable excursions to the High Dam, head towards the Unfinished Obelisk, amuse your eyes while visiting Philae Temple, Belongs to Isis and Hathor goddesses, Lunch on board your Nile Cruise. Dinner is served on board. Overnight onboard your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Kom Ombo Temples Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast on board, enjoy the scenic sailing to Kom Ombo, and explore the Temple dedicated to the two gods Sobek and Horus. Afterward, continue sailing towards Edfu, where you will have lunch on board. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple & East Bank of Luxor
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on-board. Try a new adventure by a horse-drawn carriage to visit the Edfu Temple of God Horus. Then return to the Nile Cruise, and continue sailing to Luxor via Esna lock. Once the cruise arrives in Luxor, visit Luxor Temple and Karnak complex on the east bank of Luxor. After that, you will go back to your cruise. Enjoy your dinner on-board. In the evening, enjoy the Galabia Party on the cruise. Overnight on board your Nile Cruise

itinerary.title: West Bank Tour / Luxor to sharm El-Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy your breakfast on board before disembarking at 08:00 AM; today we will say goodbye to the Nile Cruise, as today is your final departure day from your cruise. Our Egyptology tour guide will join you to visit Hatshepsut temple, Colossi of Memnon & Valley of the Kings. Finally, then manage to relax at Sharm El Sheikh Beaches, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Luxor Airport, Catch your flight to sharm El-Sheikh, arrive Sharm, transfer to your hotel, check in, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling. Overnight in Sharm El-sheikh

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at your hotel, it is your chance to escape the crowds, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Sharm El-Sheikh, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or snorkeling, optional excursion to the spectacular Ras Mohammed snorkeling Excursion, or try Desert Safari at the heart of Sinai Desert from Sharm, Amuse yourself with the amazing St. Catherine Monastery tour. Overnight in Sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure in Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at your hotel, manage to relax at the stunning beaches of Sharm El-Sheikh, different water activities are waiting for you including swimming, diving or Take a leisurely snorkeling to different spots in the area. Overnight in Sharm El-Sheikh

itinerary.title: Back to Cairo from Sharm El Sheikh
itinerary.description: Enjoy the relish of your breakfast at your hotel, today is your last day in Sharm El-sheikh, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Sharm El-Sheikh Airport, be prepared for your flight back to Cairo, Once you arrive Cairo domestic Airport, You will be escorted to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final Departure
itinerary.description: Today we will say goodbye to Egypt, once you enjoy your tasty breakfast, Ibis Egypt tours representative will escort you to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet at Cairo International Airport plus transfer to hotel by air-conditioned modern Vehicle.
